name: Bullet Express
description:
About This Game

Bullet Express is a high-octane action rogue lite looter shooter where there is tons of loot and zero junk! Join the professor as a prototype robot on a relentless mission of reclamation!

TAKE BACK THE BULLET EXPRESS

Your creator’s crowning achievement, the Bullet Express, has been hijacked by the rogue Conductor. To take back control, you must blast your way through treacherous mountains and across the speeding cars of a train that never stops, turning the Conductor's own stolen arsenal into your ultimate strength.

EVERY DROP FUELS THE FIRE

Tired of junk loot cluttering your inventory? In Bullet Express, no loot goes to waste. Combine weapon duplicates using a classic merge-3 system to synthesize higher-tier firepower, or feed unused guns directly into your primary weapon’s fusion core to unleash extra-strong modifier effects mid-fight.

FORGE PERMANENT POWER BETWEEN RUNS 

Return from every run with vital materials to craft permanent imbude attachments at the lab. Every attachment reacts differently to weapons you loot, creating a set of new weapons to discover every time!

Note from the developer: Bullet Express is currently in ALPHA. We are actively shaping the game based on player feedback. Everything from art to mechanics is subject to change as we work toward the final game!
short_desc: Reclaim the Bullet Express in this action rogue-lite looter shooter where there is no such thing as junk loot! Merge duplicates, sacrifice unwanted weapons for powerful synergies or salvage them for survival, and craft permanent modifiers to alter your playstyle!
